name: workshop-customizer
description: The ADLC platform for SAs in KiroCrew: the ADLC console (agents, knowledge bases, evaluation, A/B tests, registry, governance, Autopilot) served by this App's backend, and the Workshop customizer, where KiroCrew turns a raw customer scenario into a reviewable Scenario Pack draft, the deterministic engine validates and renders it, and a controlled AWS CLI profile syncs the approved release to the workshop EC2 before Workshop day.
author: warren830

steps.title: Engine location
steps.description: KiroCrew generation uses this App's restricted agent through the logged-in Kiro CLI. The deterministic backend imports the Scenario Pack engine from the sibling ./engine directory (or WORKSHOP_CUSTOMIZER_ENGINE). No model API key or AWS credential value is stored.
